EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description: Planting is Seedbed's combat-only isolation. An eligible card leaves this combat before entering your hand, and you get 1 Withered Husk. It does not count as play, discard, or Exhaust, so those triggers and exhaust-Curse payoffs do not fire. Permanent Curses are not deleted. Temporary Status and Curse cards are gone for this combat. A planted Blight Sprout is treated as handled and adds no Rootblight I after combat. A planted Rootblight is frozen for this combat only: it stays in your master deck at the same level, with no upgrade, split, removal, downgrade, or cleanse.
